title: Aquaponics Food Production Systems
abstract: This open access book provides an up to date overview of aquaponics, its technologies, developments, and current trends. It clarifies the difference between one-, dual-, and multi-loop aquaponics systems. It also discusses perspectives for sustainable development, management and education.

narrative:
Short impact summary

Aquaponics Food Production Systems (2019), published by Springer Nature, has been cited 487 times — enough that OpenAlex puts it in the top 1% of works in its field and year. Beyond that, it has been downloaded 50,342 times and has 1 formal review.

Full narrative

Aquaponics Food Production Systems by Simon Goddek, Alyssa Joyce, Benz Kotzen and others was published by Springer Nature in 2019. Conceptually, the work connects to Aquaponics, Production (economics), Food processing, Environmental science and Engineering.

OpenAlex records 487 citations. That places it in the top 1% of works in its field and year of publication. Citations peaked in 2024 with 81 citing works. Notable citing venues include Sustainability, Aquaculture and Horticulturae. The citing works include 384 journal articles, 39 book chapters and 17 preprints. They come from 40 countries, led by the United States, Germany and India. The citation record includes 1 formal book review.

It has been downloaded 50,342 times via OAPEN. Open Library reports a combined count of 4 reading logs and catalog editions. Its subject matter aligns with Zero hunger among the Sustainable Development Goals.

The latest English Wikipedia check verified 2 article–work reference matches. These are references or bibliography entries, which may include other editions of the same work; they do not measure readership.
